units.source_text: 只是，那时候我没有察觉名人甚至曾考虑放弃了事。

en.t: Only then, I had not realized that the Master had even considered abandoning the matter entirely.

units.source_text: 他竟是那样愤怒，又是那样沮丧。

en.t: He had been that angry, and that deeply dejected.

units.source_text: 然而，名人面对棋盘时，无论脸色还是举止都没有流露出这种情绪来。

en.t: Yet when the Master faced the go board, neither his expression nor his bearing revealed any of those feelings.

units.source_text: 谁也不曾觉察名人内心产生了那么大的动摇。

en.t: No one had noticed that such a great turmoil had arisen within the Master.
